title: Marketplace partner sync scratchpad — ben
content:
Meeting prep + scratchpad for partner / cloud marketplace sync (internal notes)

Context and goal:
- Weekly 1:1 sync with AWS/Azure/GCP partner leads and channel alliance reps. Primary goals: unblock listing portability, confirm billing integration timeline, align on co-marketing campaign milestones, and lock down next-step owners.
- This doc is a mutable scratchpad — use it for talking points, quick notes during the call, and immediate action-items to send as follow-up.

Attendees (expected):
- AWS: Priya Nair (Marketplace PM), Dan Cho (ISV Alliances) — ask: billing API cadence
- GCP: Elena Gomez (Marketplace), Sean O’Malley (Partner Eng) — ask: custom image requirements + support matrix
- Azure: Lukas Meyer (Partner Ops) — ask: commercial marketplace third-party billing steps
- Redwood: Ben Kim (GTMer), Aisha Patel (Sales Eng), Marco Rivera (Solutions)

Prep data points to have handy (bring into zoom chat early):
- Hosted API active customers: 1,150 orgs (Feb 2026), monthly ingest ~5.2B tokens total.
- Current marketplace-driven signups (last 90d): 43 orgs, ARR motion: ~$210k run-rate attributed.
- Dedicated/Private OEM/pipeline leads via marketplace: 6 active warm leads (PS engagement stage).
- Known blockers: billing mismatch for reserved commitments, CVE scanning automation required for Azure imaging, GCP image size >10GB rejection on trial.

Desired outcomes for this meeting (ranked):
1) Commit to concrete next-step owners and dates for the billing integration doc (AWS/GCP/Azure).
2) Confirm whether we can use the same signed enrollment agreement across marketplaces (legal checklist).
3) Agree on an initial co-marketing milestone: launch blog + joint webinar slot (target date window: May 11–25).
4) Identify one pilot customer we can route through each marketplace for end-to-end purchase + deployment test.

Draft agenda (25–30 min):
- 0:00–2:00 quick intros + status (Redwood quick update: usage, top partners)
- 2:00–8:00 AWS update (billing API / contract flow / portal validation)
- 8:00–14:00 GCP update (image + trial mechanics / listing metadata)
- 14:00–20:00 Azure update (offer types / 3rd-party billing steps / legal checklist)
- 20:00–26:00 cross-cloud asks & blockers (we call these out and assign owners)
- 26:00–30:00 confirm action items, owners, dates, and next sync cadence

High-priority talking points (use bullet soundbites):
- "We need billing parity across marketplaces for committed reserved capacity — otherwise our sales ops work doubles."
- "For the pilot customer flows, can we get a stubbed purchase-to-provision test account from each marketplace team by April 3?"
- "Security scan remediation: if marketplace-imposed scan fails, what’s the expected timeline for rescanning once we patch?"
- "We want a visible listing availability SLA — if a partner listing fails certification, what escalation path exists?"

Open questions to surface live:
- AWS: Is there a hardened plan for handling metered usage + seat/license based offers for Dedicated commits? Who owns price reconciliation? (Expected answer: Marketplace billing team + ISV finance; get a POC email)
- GCP: Can we use Container-optimized OS image or do we need full GKE operator packaging? Is there a size limit workaround for our v2 private images?
- Azure: Confirm whether third-party billing requires partner onboarding at MPN level X or Y; can our legal e-sign flow satisfy marketplace requirements?

Quick technical checklist (tell SRE/infra afterwards):
- Confirm CVE scanning pipeline integration with marketplace feedback hook (ticket: JIRA-SEC-829).
- Provide sample AMI/container digest + SBOM by 2026-03-20.
- Add marketplace-flagged telemetry off by default in Private deployments (compliance ask).

Notes-to-self / conversational cues:
- If they push long lead times, offer a staged approach: 1) list as trial-only with manual provisioning; 2) flip on auto-billing after integrations complete.
- Emphasize Redwood Optimize business case: lower unit costs -> better margin share for both us and partner customers on marketplace billbacks.
- When they ask about security, call out our existing SOC2 + third-party pentest cadence and link to the certs post-meeting.

During-call shorthand (fill live):
- AWS: billing API owner: Priya? -> PRIYA.EMAIL@aws.com (confirm) — notes: __
- GCP: image size workaround owner: Sean? -> SEAN.EMAIL@google.com — notes: __
- Azure: MPN level needed: Lukas said "level 2"? confirm, then: __

Immediate follow-ups to send within 24h (draft email bullets):
- Thanks + summary of owners/dates from meeting.
- Attach: SBOM + minimal manifest we promised, link to Confluence checklist.
- Ask for POC emails for billing reconciliation and an invite to the marketplace test portal.

Action items (template) — populate names & due dates during meeting:
- [ ] Draft billing integration spec (owner: Ben) — due: 2026-03-17
- [ ] Provide SBOM + image digest (owner: Marco) — due: 2026-03-20
- [ ] Legal checklist: single-sign enrollment agreement feasibility (owner: Aisha) — due: 2026-03-24
- [ ] Pilot customer ID + purchase route test (owner: partner POC) — due: 2026-04-03
- [ ] Schedule webinar date + draft co-marketing one-pager (owner: Marketing / partner) — due: 2026-04-15

Possible risks and mitigation notes:
- Risk: Marketplace billing cadence delays cause revenue recognition lag.
  Mitigation: Offer manual invoicing for first 60 days for pilot deals; capture usage logs for reconciliation.
- Risk: Image certification fails due to size/time.
  Mitigation: Propose a lighter-weight image / operator pattern and ask GCP for an exception for pilot.
- Risk: Legal review time.
  Mitigation: Share a redlined enrollment agreement in advance; get an early legal sync (Aisha to schedule).

Post-meeting email template (short):
Subject: Thanks + Redwood x [AWS/GCP/Azure] marketplace sync — action items
Hi [names],
Thanks for the quick sync — below are the main owners and next steps we covered. If anything is missing or misattributed please flag.
[copy action items list] 
Att: SBOM, minimal manifest, link to marketplace playbook

Random scratch (ideas to pitch later):
- One-click deploy marketplace tile that pre-provisions Dedicated pool + private VPC peering (sales win for larger ISVs).
- Co-funded usage credits for first 3 months to pull through trial conversions.

End-of-doc: quick checklist to save to Confluence after sync:
- Update marketplace-playbook with confirmed enrollment flow per cloud (Ben)
- Create JIRA task for image-size workaround (eng infra)
- Upload SBOM artifact to secure bucket and grant partner teams read access

----
Version notes (doc lifecycle):
- v0.1 (2026-02-20) initial brain dump
- v0.2 (2026-03-10) updated with attendee list + priorities

(TODO: after sync, convert the action items into a tidy sheet for tracking and attach to the partner Confluence page.)
